description: This file is a Perl script used for flashing firmware on a Linksys ADSL2MUE device. It includes socket communication, device discovery via broadcast, FTP control interactions, and file transfer operations specific to the device's firmware update process.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for setting environment variables, rebooting the device, and retrieving environment variables, tailored for interacting with the device via FTP during firmware flashing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script and exits.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server with the provided arguments.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get an environment variable via FTP.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the FTP server and returns whether it succeeded.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
